_notes.source: Live https://tradeify.co/ pricing table read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 (Growth, Select and Lightning tabs, every size, and the Select 40%/50% consistency switch), plus https://tradeify.co/become-an-affiliate (FAQ answers opened) and https://tradeify.co/affiliate-terms-and-conditions. Rules otherwise from official help-centre articles read via Internet Archive copies (June-Sept 2026), listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: All prices USD, one-time payments (no subscription). standard = the struck-through list price on the live pricing table; promo = the price shown next to it with code GEMS (30% off). On 2026-10-20 the site banner read 'GET 30% OFF WITH CODE "GEMS" - ENDS 31 OCTOBER, 11:59PM EST', so GEMS was still live then (it was previously recorded as ending 15 Oct). Re-check after 31 Oct 2026. Select prices are for the default 40% consistency option; choosing 50% consistency costs $135 / $205 / $329 / $459 (GEMS $95 / $144 / $230 / $321). A 5-account bundle gives a further 5% off. All sales are final, no refunds.
_notes.billing: One-time purchase for every account type; no monthly fees and no activation fees on any current product. Growth and Select evaluations have no time limit. Reset fees (one-time, live pricing table 2026-10-03): Growth $60 / $95 / $169 / $229 (Pricing Reference article in June listed $60 / $95 / $155 / $215); Select $75 / $109 / $169 / $239 (Pricing Reference listed $60 for Select 25K). Select resets limited to 10 per evaluation per 30 days. Lightning Funded has no resets. Maximum 15 evaluation purchases per 30 days; maximum 5 sim funded accounts at once.
_notes.rules_detail: Growth evaluation: profit target, EOD trailing max drawdown, soft-breach daily loss limit (trading stops for the day, account not failed), no consistency rule in the evaluation, can pass in 1 trading day; the 35% consistency rule applies to funded payouts. Select evaluation: no daily loss limit, EOD trailing drawdown, 40% consistency rule in the evaluation only (optional 50% add-on), minimum 3 trading days; after passing the trader permanently picks Select Flex (payout every 5 winning days, no daily loss limit, no consistency) or Select Daily (daily payout eligibility after a buffer, daily loss limit $500 / $1,000 / $1,250 / $1,750). Lightning Funded: no evaluation, funded straight away; payout profit goal $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 for payout 1, then $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $4,500; consistency 20% for payout 1, 25% for payout 2, 30% after; no minimum trading days; daily loss limit none (25K) or $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,000. max_contracts = mini contracts (10 micros = 1 mini). Drawdown on all plans trails the end-of-day balance but is enforced in real time, and locks $100 above the starting balance once reached.
_notes.payout_caps: No single cap per size, so payout_cap is null. Growth funded max per payout (payouts 1 / 2 / 3 / 4+): 25K $1,000 each; 50K $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000; 100K $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $4,000; 150K $2,500 / $3,000 / $4,000 / $5,000. Lightning (payouts 1-3 / 4+): 25K fixed $1,000; 50K $2,000 / $2,500; 100K $2,500 / $3,000; 150K $3,000 / $3,500. Select Flex (accounts bought after 1 Sep 2026): up to 50% of total profit, capped at $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,500 / $4,500. Select Daily (after 1 Sep 2026): up to 2x profit since last payout, capped at $600 / $1,250 / $1,750 / $2,500.
_notes.profit_split: 90/10 on all sim funded accounts (Growth, Select, Lightning) from the first payout. Elite Live accounts are 80/20.
_notes.fee_refund: Pricing Reference states all sales are final and no fees are refunded, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.platforms: Broker chosen at checkout: Tradovate (gives Tradovate, NinjaTrader, TradingView), Rithmic (gives Tradesea, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader) or WealthCharts (WealthCharts platform only). Same price for every broker.
_notes.other_products: Select 300K exists as a limited release ($449 list price on the page data, hidden from the public pricing table, KYC before purchase, max 3 per user, no resets) - not listed. Tradeify also runs '247' (a separate 24/7 perps/stocks/crypto product), a free Premier Trading League competition, the Tradeify Elite live program and the Slay Markets brokerage (Tradeify Brokerage LLC, a CFTC-registered introducing broker) - none listed here.
_notes.company: Official footer: Tradeify Holdings, Corp., 1700 S. Dixie Highway, Suite 305, Boca Raton, FL 33432, USA; payment agent Novaflame LTD (Cyprus). Help centre names Brett Simberkoff as founder and CEO. No official page states a founding date (third-party sites disagree: 2022 vs 2024), so founded is null.
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: The site advertises pass rates, payout totals and a '0% payout denial' figure; none of these are reproduced here (directory policy).
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Tradeify page, or not expressible as one number (see the notes above). Check the live pricing table before publishing.
_notes.company_check: Re-checked 2026-10-20: no founding date on official pages, founded still null. Google Maps search for Tradeify in Boca Raton found no Tradeify listing.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://tradeify.co/become-an-affiliate (FAQ, 2026-10-20): 15% commission on Growth/Advanced plans, 10% on Straight to Sim Funded (Lightning) plans, 5% on evaluation resets. Cookie: 60 days via the affiliate link; another affiliate's discount code used at checkout takes priority (last click). Minimum payout $1,000, request-based once per calendar month, paid via Plane; unclaimed commissions forfeited after 90 days. Custom discount codes on request through the Help Center (send reach and engagement data). Comparison sites and UAE-based affiliates are not mentioned either way on the page or the affiliate terms. Apply: https://app-f.tradeify.co/affiliate (needs a Tradeify account).

firm.name: Tradeify
firm.about: Tradeify is a futures-only prop firm based in Boca Raton, Florida that sells one-time-fee evaluations (Growth and Select) and instant Lightning Funded accounts from $25K to $150K, all with end-of-day trailing drawdown.

countries.notes: Based on country of permanent residence, not where you are physically trading. Crimea is also listed. Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). Partial restriction: residents of 27 more places can buy evaluations and get paid on sim funded accounts but cannot move to a live (Elite) account. These include the United Arab Emirates, plus Antarctica, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Canada (Ontario residents only), China and Hong Kong (possible exception after AML review), Croatia, Gibraltar, Haiti, Jordan, Kenya, Monaco, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, North Macedonia, Philippines, Qatar, Romania, Senegal, Serbia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Tanzania and Turkmenistan. The help centre blocks automated checks, so this was read from an Internet Archive copy of the official page (article updated 2 April 2026, captured 10 June 2026).
